notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for joined-federate MOM interactions-received counts. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard MIM declarations, HLAvariableArray, HLAfixedRecord, HLAinteger32BE, HLAbyte, and the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and application interaction/parameter names. It verifies reliable and best-effort interaction delivery, transportation-type change confirmation, nested MOM data-element decoding, receiver metadata, and cleanup without provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador joined-federate MOM interaction-count and transportation-change services with FederateAmbassador interaction and confirmation callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador MOM, interaction, transportation, and data-element declarations
